prepends.text:
> **Merged-skill note.** This is the upstream *Teaching Skills* README, kept as published apart
> from the count and naming corrections logged in [MERGE_NOTES.md](MERGE_NOTES.md). In the merged
> `teaching-skill` skill the 15 skills are modules of one skill: start at
> [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) (the router). Each module's entry file is `WORKFLOW.md` (not `SKILL.md`) and
> the plugin/CI files are archived under `upstream/`. Install steps for the merged skill are in
> [MERGE_NOTES.md](MERGE_NOTES.md), not below.

> **合并技能说明。** 本文件是上游 *Teaching Skills* 的中文 README，除 [MERGE_NOTES.md](MERGE_NOTES.md)
> 记录的数量与命名更正外保持原样。在合并后的 `teaching-skill` 技能中，15 个技能是同一技能的模块：
> 请从 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)（路由入口）开始。各模块的入口文件为 `WORKFLOW.md`（而非 `SKILL.md`），
> 插件/CI 文件归档在 `upstream/` 下。合并技能的安装步骤见 [MERGE_NOTES.md](MERGE_NOTES.md)，而非下文。
